title: Slow Cooker Sausage Casserole
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 3
ingredients: 6 skinny pork sausages (mine are from Aldi 74cals each)
method: Fry off your sausages in a pan until browned then add into the slow cooker with the sliced carrots and leek
Season with rosemary and thyme
Add in the tomato puree and the beef stock and mix well
Cover over and cook on low for 4 hours or high for 2
For the mash, peel and chop the potatoes and boil for 15 minutes until soft
Mash and add in the butter
Around 20 minutes before the end add in the gravy granules to the slow cooker and mix well allowing the sauce to thicken up
Serve up and enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Pasta Bolognaise
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 5
method: Brown off the mince beef in a pan with the stock pot
Transfer into the slow cooker with the onion, pepper and mushrooms and all of the seasonings
Pour in the passata, tomato puree and the balsamic vinegar and mix well
Cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
Around 20 minutes before the end boil the pasta until al dente
Add the pasta to the slow cooker with the parmesan and mix well
Cook for a further 10 minutes
Serve up and sprinkle over a dash of parmesan to finish!

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Curry
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 7
ingredients: 60g (dried weight) mayflower curry powder (found in Heron foods or B&M)
method: To the slow cooker add the sliced onion, mushrooms and chicken breasts
Season with salt, pepper, garlic and Chinese 5 spice
Mix the curry powder with 200ml boiling water and pour this in the slow cooker
Mix well and cover over, cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4 hours
After the 2 (or 4) hours, remove the chicken breast and shred with a knife and fork and put back into the slow cooker
Add in the frozen peas, mix and cover over for another 20 minutes
Boil your rice during this time
Serve up and enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Creamy Beef Orzo Ragu
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 9
method: Fry off your beef mince until browned

Transfer the beef into the slow cooker along with the diced onion, grated carrot, diced red pepper, mushrooms, tsp lazy garli, salt , pepper, oregano, chilli flakes, tomato puree and tinned chopped tomatoes
Add in the beef stock pot and around 100ml of water (more or less depending on how many portions you are making & how wide your slow cooker is)
Stir well and cover over, cook on high for around 2 hours or slow for 4 hours
After 2 hours on high, add in the orzo, chopped cherry tomatoes, frozen peas and cream, give this a good mix (you may need a splash more water to cover the orzo)
Re-cover and cook for a further 20-30 minutes or until the orzo is fully cooked
Add in the parmesan cheese and mix, let this simmer for 5 more minutes before serving

title: Slow Cooker Chinese Chicken Noodles
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 11
ingredients: 2 nests of noodles (250g dried weight fine egg noodles)
method: Place the chicken breast into the slow cooker along with the diced onion and mushrooms
Mix the curry powder with around 150ml water and pour in
Pour in the coconut milk and stir well
Cover over and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
After 2 hours (or 4 if cooked on low) remove the chicken breast and shred with a knife and fork
Return the chicken into the slow cooker along with the dried egg noodles
Pour in the chicken stock (you may need more/ less but just ensure the noodles are all covered)
Cook for a further 10 minutes
Serve up once the noodles are cooked and top with some sliced spring onion!

title: Slow Cooker Beef Keema Curry
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 13
method: First brown off the beef in a pan then transfer into the slow cooker
Dice the onion and pepper and add this to the slow cooker
Season with salt & pepper and add in the garlic, tikka paste, tomato puree and passata along with a dash of sweetener
Stir well and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
At the end add in the frozen peas, stir and cook for a further 15-20 minutes
Meanwhile boil the rice as per the packet instructions
Serve up & enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Mince & Dumplings
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 15
method: Brown off the mince in a pan then transfer over to the slow cooker
Add in the diced onion and grated carrot
Pour in the tomato puree, garlic and Worcester sauce
Season with salt and pepper and the oregano, rosemary and thyme
Pour in the beef stock and stir
Cover over and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
Add in the gravy granules and a spash of water and cover for another 10 minutes
Make the dumplings as per the packet instructions
Transfer the beef into an oven proof dish and top with the dumplings
Cover over and bake in the oven for 10 minutes and then for 5 minutes remove the cover to allow the dumplings to crisp slightly
Microwave the mash and serve up!

title: Slow Cooker Shredded Enchiladas
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 17
method: Add the chicken breasts to the slow cooker along with the diced onion
Add the listed spices & seasonings with the passata & black beans and give it a good stir
Cover over and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
Once cooked, remove the chicken and shred with a knife and fork
Stir the chicken back into the sauce with the sweet corn
Shred the mini wraps and stir these into the sauce too ensure they are all covered with the sauce
Sprinkle over the cheese mix along with the sliced spring onion and sliced chilli
Leave for 5-10 minutes until all the cheese has melted then serve & enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Nandos Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 19
ingredients: Optional topping: nandos perinaise (not counted in macros)
method: Tip: if you're in decisive pre cook your chicken so it's ready to top on what ever dish you decide to make!
Add all of the ingredients into the slow cooker, mix well
Cook on high for 45 minutes
Give it all a stir round and continue to cook until the rice has soaked up all of the water
Shred the chicken and drizzle over the Nandos sauce
Optional topping a drizzle of Nanados perinaise

title: Slow Cooker Meatball Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 21
ingredients: 12 meatballs (to reduce the calories you could use the Aldi 5% fat meatballs, I used Muscle foods)
method: Brown your meatballs off on all sides in the pan then add to the slow cooker
Dice up your onion and pepper and add this to the slow cooker
Sprinkle over the sugar, lazy garlic, salt, pepper and oregano
Pour in the tinned chopped tomatoes and the dried pasta
Pour in the beef stock (add more/ less depending on the size of your slow cooker so that all of the pasta is covered)
Mix well and leave for 20 minutes
After 20 minutes stir and re-cover
After another 10 minutes stir through the Philadelphia and leave to sit for 5 minutes before serving
Season with some parsley and a sprinkling of parmesan cheese

title: Slow Cooker Beef Pie
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 25
ingredients: 1/2 of the slow cooker beef in red
wine sauce (see the separate recipe card for this)
method: Add half of the slow cooker beef in red wine sauce into an oven proof dish
Add in 2tbsp gravy granules and stir to help thicken up the sauce
Egg wash the sides of the dish
Top with the puff pastry and egg wash
Prick some holes into the top of the pastry
Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 10 minutes or in the oven for around 15 untill all the pastry has gone golden and crispy
Serve with some pre made mash potato
Sprinkle some pepper and mint sauce on top if you like!

title: Slow Cooker Beef Tagliatelle Ragu
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 27
ingredients: 1/2 of the slow cooker beef in red
method: Warm up the other half of the beef slow cooker recipe and break up the beef into shredded pieces with a knife and fork
Boil your pasta as per the instructions (8-10 minutes for dry or 3 minutes for fresh)
Drain and add to the pan with the beef (or the slow cooker if you’re still using that)
Stir well so its coated in the sauce
Season with some black pepper
Sprinkle over 3/4 of the parmesan and stir
Dish up and top with the remaining parmesan

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Satay Noodles
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 29
method: To the slow cooker, add in the diced onion, garlic, curry powder, dark soy, sweet chilli, peanut butter, chicken stock and the chicken thighs
Give it a good mix and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
Remove the chicken once cooked and shred with a knife and fork
Add in the corn flour and stir
Re-add the chicken into the sauce and mix well
Cover over and cook for a further 10 minutes until the sauce thickens uo
Meanwhile boil the noodles as per the packet instructions
Serve up and top with a sliced spring onion

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Satay Curry
source: Fit Food Diary: Slow Cooker Recipes, p. 31
ingredients: Optional: prawn crackers (not included in macros but are quite low cal generally to add as an extra!)
method: To the slow cooker, add in the diced onion, garlic, curry powder, dark soy, sweet chilli, peanut butter, chicken stock and the chicken thighs
Give it a good mix and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
Remove the chicken once cooked and shred with a knife and fork
Add in the corn flour and stir
Re-add the chicken into the sauce and mix well
Cover over and cook for a further 10 minutes until the sauce thickens up
Meanwhile boil your green beans and microwave the rice as per the packet instructions
Serve up and top with a sliced spring onion

title: High Volume Spag Bol
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 5
method: Put the pasta onto boil while you cook the sauce
In a large pan add in the lazy garlic and diced onion & let this soften for a few minutes before adding in the sliced celery and carrots
Allow the veggies to soften before adding in the lean mince beef
Once the beef begins to brown, add in the stock pot, salt, pepper and some paprika
Once the beef is almost fully cooked, add in the tinned tomatoes, tomato puree and
Worcester sauce
Bring the heat down to a simmer for 10-15 mins
When the pasta is cooked though add this to the sauce
Divide up into 4 meal prep dishes and top with some parmesan cheese

title: Chicken Fajita Orzo
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 7
method: First, coat the chicken breast in half the fajita seasoning and the garlic & herb seasoning
Slice the red onion and add this to the pan with the chicken
Once the chicken is sealed, add in the sliced pepper and sundried tomatoes
Add in your dried orzo with half of the chicken stock and give it a good mix through
Let this soak up the water for 10 mins before adding the rest of the stock along with the rest of the fajita seasoning and the tomato puree
Let it simmer for another 15 mins before adding in some salt and pepper
Once all the water has been soaked up by the orzo top with some fresh coriander and spring onions

title: Chicken Sausage Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 9
method: Boil your pasta and put your sausages onto a grill while you make the sauce in a separate pan
In a large pan add in your lazy garlic, diced red pepper and sliced marinated tomatoes
Once the sausages are cooked, chop them up into small pieces and add them to the pan
Season with garlic powder, Italian herbs and paprika
Stir in your coconut milk and tomato puree
Add in around 10g parmesan (the remaining parmesan is to add once all cooked)
Once the sauce is combined, add in your baby spinach to wilt down
Add the drained pasta once its cooked and mix well into the sauce
Divide into 4 meal prep boxes and top with the remaining parmesan cheese

title: Spicy Peanut Noodles
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 11
ingredients: 30g powdered peanut butter (or your own choice of peanut butter but alter calories accordingly)
method: Dice up your chicken breast and coat well in 1tsp chilli powder, garlic powder, 15ml sriracha sauce and 50ml of the soy sauce
Fry the chicken until cooked though and set to the side
While you make the sauce set your noodles off to boil
For the sauce in the same pan which you cooked the chicken add the sesame oil, garlic puree, sesame seeds, chilli flakes, 70ml soy sauce, the peanut butter and honey
Stir until this is all combined
Once you have the sauce consistency, add the chicken back in
Drain the noodles and mix well into the sauce
Divide into 4 meal prep boxes and top with sliced spring onions and a sprinkle of sesame seeds

title: Feta & Salmon Orzo
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 13
method: Boil the orzo in one pan for 15-20 mins
Wrap the salmon filets in foil and place in the oven to bake for 20 mins (or as per the packet)
While the salmon and orzo cook in one large bowl combine: salad leaves, sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes
Add in the crumbled feta and give a good mix
For the sauce: in a bowl add the Greek yogurt, perinaise and 2 tbsp paprika
Add the sauce to the salad and give a good mix through
Once the orzo is cooked add this and mix this in too
Once the salmon is cooked through shred this with a knife and fork and mix into the salad and orzo
Separate into 2 dishes and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days

title: Spicy Salmon & Veg
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 15
method: Fry the salmon in a pan on both sides for around 8-10 mins until cooked through and peel off the skin
Set this to the side and add in the bag of
Mexican rice, sliced red pepper, asparagus and frozen peas
Season this mix with a tbsp of paprika
Share the veg & rice mix out into 2 meal prep dishes and top with the salmon
Drizzle half of the sriracha mayo over each meal

title: Chinese Chicken Curry
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 17
method: Add the lazy garlic and diced chicken breast to the pan and fry off for a few minutes
Dice up your red onion and add this to the pan with the chicken
Season with some salt and pepper
While this cooks, mix your curry powder with some boiling water, add a little water at a time until it's at your desired consistency
Add this to the pan with the chicken
Once it's almost cooked through add your frozen peas for the last 5 minutes
Cook your rice in the microwave
Separate it all into 4 meal prep dishes
This will keep in the fridge for up to 3 days

title: Teriyaki Salmon & Egg Fried Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 19
method: Cover the salmon fillets in the teriyaki sauce and place in the fridge for 30mins (or as long as you can) to marinate
Dice up your red onion & pepper
Add both salmon filets to the pan (skin side down) and fry off on both sides
Peel the skin off when you flip the salmon
Dice the salmon up and set to the side
In the same pan add the onion & pepper and fry until softened
Add in your rice and crack 1 egg
Keep mixing this round and add in the soy sauce
Add in your frozen peas and season with salt, pepper and garlic seasoning
Share out into 2 meal prep dishes and top with the teriyaki salmon

title: Nandos Peri Wraps
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 21
method: Cover the chicken in the seasoning and fry off in the pan
Add in a diced red pepper
While this is cooking prepare the sauce in a separate bowl
Add in the perinaise and Philadelphia and mix together
Once the chicken and pepper is cooked add this to the bowl with the sauce and coat well
In each wrap add the lettuce, cucumber, chicken and Doritos and wrap tightly
Fry each wrap on both sides untl really crispy
Wrap in tin foil and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days

title: Fajita Mince Orzo
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 23
method: Fry off the lean mince with some lazy garlic, salt, pepper and paprika
Add in the diced red onion and add in all of your fajita seasoning
Once the beef is well cooked, add in the tomato puree
Add in the dried orzo and the stock pot in around 500ml water
Leave this for around 15-20 mins stirring occasionally
Once the orzo has soaked up the water, add in the black beans and grated cheese for the last 5-10 mins
A little more water may be needed if the orzo isn't fully cooked
Separate out into 3 meal prep dishes

title: Burger Pasta Salad
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 25
method: Boil the pasta in one pan and fry off the burgers on both sides in another
Meanwhile, assemble your salad in two tuppa- wear boxes
Once the burgers are cooked, add a slice of cheese on top of each to melt
Add the cooked pasta to the meal pre tubs and top with the cheesy burger
Add 15g of peri mayonnaise on top of each burger and top with your jalapeños

title: Chicken & Halloumi Mozarella Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 27
method: Boil the pasta in one pan and fry off chicken in another with some lazy garlic
Grill the halloumi while you cook the chicken
Season the chicken with paprika and Italian seasoning
Once the chicken is cooked, add the passata and sriracha
Mix it well and add in the mozzarella
When the pasta is cooked, add it to the pan with the chicken and cheesy sauce
Separate out into 2 dishes and top with halloumi

title: Lasagne
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 29
ingredients: lazy garlic, Italian herbs & onion salt
method: Add some lazy garlic to the pan along with your 5% reduced fat lean mince
Season with onion salt, paprika and Italian seasoning
Add in your diced onion and pepper
Add in the tinned tomatoes, passata and balsamic vinegar and mix well
Add in the mushrooms
Pour in the beef stock and cook for 10-15 mins on low heat
In another pan add the butter, milk, flour, reduced fat cheese and parmesan and mix until a nice thick, creamy sauce is formed
In an oven proof dish add 1 layer of mince, 1 layer of lasagne sheets and 1 layer of creamy sauce and repeat
On the top layer add your grated mozzarella
Bake in the oven on 180 for around 30 mins
This makes 4 portions, keep in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze

title: Penne Arrabbiata
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 31
method: Add some lazy garlic to the pan along with your diced onion and chicken breast (meanwhile the pasta is on the boil in a separate pan)
Season with onion salt, oregano, basil and paprika
Pour in the passata and tomato puree with the chicken stock
Mix in the grated cheese and leave until thickened
Once the pasta is cooked, mix this into the sauce and serve into 2 dishes or meal prep tubs

title: Teriyaki Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 33
method: Marinate the diced chicken in the teriyaki sauce and fry off until cooked through then set aside
In the same pan, fry off your veggies in some lazy garlic, soy sauce and honey
Once the veggies have softened, add in your cooked rice and mix well
Add the chicken back in and mix well
Serve into two meal prep dishes seasoning with salt and pepper
Optional to top with the mayflower curry sauce

title: Cheesy Bacon Pasta Bake
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 35
method: Put the pasta onto boil
In a separate pan fry off the diced onion and sliced bacon rashers
Season with paprika, chilli flakes & lazy garlic
Once its nice and crispy, remove some from the pan for the toppings later
Add in the passata, Philadelphia & sriracha sauce
Once the pasta is cooked, mix it into the sauce
Transfer into an oven proof dish
Top with the mozzarella & red leicester and the bacon topping you set aside earlier
Bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes until the cheese is all melted and the bacon is crispy
Share into 3 meal prep tubs

title: Tuscan Chicken Orzo
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 37
ingredients: 80g marinated tomatoes (the aldi ones are good for the cals)
method: Fry off the diced chicken breast with 1/2 a diced red onion
Season with onion salt, chicken seasoning and oregano
Once the chicken is cooked, add in the dried orzo and chicken stock with around 300ml water
Pop a cover on the pan and let the orzo soak up the water for 20-30 mins (stir occasionally so it does not stick to the pan)
Add in some spinach for the last 5 minutes to wilt down
Add in the tomatoes, tomato puree, philadelphia cheese and grated parmesan
Stir until you have a thick, creamy consistency
Season with some pepper then share into 2 meal prep tubs

title: Tuscan Chicken Wrap
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 39
ingredients: 60g marinated tomatoes (aldi ones are good for the cals)
method: In a pan fry off the diced chicken breast in a tbsp of each seasoning
Add in the marinated tomatoes to fry. for a few minutes
While the chicken is cooking in a bowl combine the spinach, Philadelphia cheese, parmesan
Add the tomatoes and chicken to the bowl and mix thoroughly until its a nice creamy sauce
Share out the mixture between 2 wraps
Fold up and fry the wraps on both sides until crispy
Wrap up in tin foil to use as meal prep

title: Spicy, Cheesy Loaded Fries
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 41
method: Chop up your potato into chips and cover in fry light
Season with garlic powder, oregano and paprika
Bake in the oven (turning half way) for 20-30 mins
While the chips are baking, dice up your chicken and season in garlic powder, paprika and oregano
Fry this off and add in 2 sliced spring onions and once its cooked though add in the passata, sriracha chilli sauce and mozzarella
Once the chips are nice and crispy, separate them out into 2 boxes and top each with half of the chicken
Season with sriracha mayo (5ml on each) and some more spring onions

title: Thai Red Chicken Meatballs
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 43
ingredients: 1 Thai red curry pack from aldi (or get some Thai red paste, low fat coconut milk and Thai spices)
12 chicken meatballs (I cut mine in half to make 24)
method: Add your Mangetout and baby corn to the pan and a small portion of the curry paste and 2tbsp of the milk
Once the paste becomes fragrant, add in the rest of the paste and the meatballs
When the meatballs are almost cooked through add the rest of milk and the spring onion
Cook your rice ( I used 1 1/2 bags of microwave rice and shared into 3 portions
Top with some fresh chilli

title: Spicy Mozzarella Meatballs
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 45
ingredients: 12 5% fat lean meatballs (I cut them in half to make 24)
method: Put your spaghetti on to the boil
In a separate pan fry off your diced red onion and meatballs in paprika, onion salt and garlic seasoning
Add in the passata, Philadelphia, grated mozzarella and the sriracha until you have a nice thick creamy sauce
Once the pasta is cooked, add it to the pan with the meatballs to coat it in the sauce
Share out into 3 dishes and sprinkle some parmesan on top

title: Creamy Chicken & Chorizo Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 47
ingredients: 140g dried weight pasta (I used the chickpea protein pasta from Aldi but any is okay)
method: Boil your pasta in slightly salted water meanwhile the chicken sausages are cooking under the grill
In another pan add in the chorizo, after a few minutes add the diced onion and marinated tomatoes
Add in the tomato puree, cream, parmesan cheese and a splash of the pasta water
Add in the spinach to wilt down and once the pasta and sausages are cooked add these too
Mix in the seasoning
Separate into 2 meal prep tubs and this will keep in the fridge for up to 3 days

title: Chicken Mac & Cheese
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 49
method: Boil your pasta in slightly salted water
In a separate pan, cook your diced chicken breast, once cooked through set it aside
In a pan, add your flour & milk and stir until it starts to thicken
Add in your seasonings and then stir again
Add in your cheese (leave some for the topping) and stir until nice and thick
Once the pasta is cooked add this and the chicken into the cheese sauce
Transfer into an oven proof dish and top with the remaining cheese and place into the oven on 180 degrees for 10 minutes
Top with some dried parsley

title: Sweet Chilli Sticky Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 51
ingredients: 250g bag of microwave egg fried rice
method: Cover your chicken in the seasoning and fry off with your sliced red pepper
While that is cooking, in a bowl combine the honey, soy, tomato puree and sweet chilli sauce and mix well
When the chicken has cooked, pour over the sauce on a high heat until its really thick and sticky
Once this is cooked, set the chicken to the side and add the rice to the pan with the frozen peas
Share it out into 2 portions and top with some sesame seeds

title: Creamy Garlic Chicken & Chorizo Gnocchi
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 53
method: Grill your sausages while you cook the rest
Add your lazy garlic and chorizo to the pan and fry off for a few minutes
Add in your dried orzo along with the chicken stock, stir and cover over
Leave this to cook for around 20-30 mins stirring occasionally (you may need to add more water as the orzo soaks it up)
When the water is fully soaked up, add in the parmesan cheese and the Philadelphia and mix well
Once the sausages are cooked, slice them up and add to the orzo 5 minutes before the end add in the frozen peas
Serve with grilled asparagus & season with pepper and parsley

title: Chipotle & Honey Salmon Tacos
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 55
method: Take the skin off the salmon and coat in the marinade and leave at room temperature for 10 minutes
Cook in the air fryer for around 15 mins (you can also fry this or bake in the oven)
Once cooked through, shred the salmon with a knife and fork
Lightly toast your mini tortillas and spread the taco sauce evenly on each one
Layer with the red cabbage & carrots (or salad)
Layer with the shredded salmon & season with parsley

title: Nandos Chicken & Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 57
method: Marinate your chicken breasts in the seasonings listed, half the Nandos sauce and a tbsp of lemon juice
Bake in the air fryer or in the oven
While that is cooking, in a pan add your diced onion and red pepper along with the rice seasonings listed
Add in your tomato puree and give it a mix
Add in your uncooked rice and around 300ml water, stir and cover over for around 20 mins (it may need stirring occasionally)
The rice may need topping up with water and re-covering until it's cooked through
Separate the rice into 2 dishes topping each with one of the chicken breasts, the remaining
Nandos sauce and some fresh coriander

title: Sweet Chilli Crispy Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 59
ingredients: 2 tsp light & 2 tsp dark soy sauce
30g reduced sugar sweet chilli sauce (blue dragon) (optional topping)
method: In a bowl add your diced chicken breast and mix with the lazy garlic, soy sauces and cornflour
Mix this well until all of the chicken is coated
Add the chicken to a pan or air fryer until cooked through and crispy
Meanwhile slice your red pepper into strips and dice up your spring onions
Take your chicken out of the pan/ air fryer and coat in the honey
Add it back into the air fryer with the red peppers and spring onions for another 5 minutes
While this is cooking, microwave your rice
Share into 2 portions and top with sesame seeds & some sweet chilli sauce (optional)

title: Creamy Spicy Sticky Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 61
ingredients: 3 nests of whole wheat noodles (50g each dried weight)
Onion salt, garlic powder and black
method: Put your noodles on to the boil
In a separate pan add your diced chicken breast and cover with the oil, seasonings and half of the soy sauce
Once the chicken is cooked add in the sliced spring onions
Mix in the sriracha, honey, the rest of the soy sauce and the sesame seeds
Put it onto a high heat so that the chicken goes extra sticky
Once the noodles are cooked add these to the pan and mix through the Philadelphia
Separate into 3 meal prep dishes and top with some more spring onion and sesame seeds
This will keep in the fridge for up to 3 days

title: Chicken Alfredo
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 63
method: Spray your chicken in low cal cooking spray or olive oil spray and cover in the seasonings
Air fry on 180 for 15 minutes or bake in the oven
Put your pasta on to boil
In another pan pour in the milk, mozzarella and
Philadelphia and mix until combined
Add in some garlic and Italian herbs
Once the pasta is cooked, add it to the sauce and mix until it is coated
Separate into 2 meal prep tubs and add the chicken on top
Season with a sprinkle of parmesan and parsley

title: Sweet Chilli Chicken One Pot Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 65
ingredients: 40g reduced sugar sweet chilli sauce (Blue dragon was the brand I used)
method: Dice up your chicken breasts and season in the lazy garlic, paprika, chilli flakes, soy sauce and the sweet chilli
Mix until all the chicken is coated and fry off
Once the chicken is cooked through take it out the pan and pop it to the side to marinate
In the same pan add in your diced red onion and pepper
Then add in your dried rice and the chicken stock
Add in the tomato puree and mix through
Let this cook for 20 minutes stirring occasionally and adding in extra water as and when is needed
Once the rice is cooked add in the chicken and mix
Share into 2 meal prep dishes and top with sliced spring onion and sesame seeds

title: Thai Red Salmon Rice Bowl
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 67
method: Dice up your salmon fillets spray with cooking spray and cover in the Thai red paste
Air fry the salmon for 10 minutes or bake in the oven for around 18-20 minutes at 180 degrees
Microwave your rice and start building your bowl with the rice in the bottom
Top with cucumber, spring onions, the cooked salmon and sriracha mayo
Sprinkle some sesame seeds on top to finish

title: Chicken Fajita Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 69
method: Dice up your chicken breast and cover in the fajita spices- air fry for 15 minutes or fry off in a pan until cooked through
Boil your pasta in one pan
In another pan, fry off a tsp of lazy garlic, your diced onion and red pepper and sprinkle a little more fajita seasoning over the veg
Mix in your tomato and chilli passata, lightest
Philadelphia
Add the chicken into the sauce and your cooked pasta
Stir in the grated cheese
Top with some black pepper and chilli flakes

title: Creamy Chilli Chicken Noodle
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 71
ingredients: 2 nests of medium egg noodles (239 calories each)
method: Cover your chicken breast in salt, pepper and paprika and air fry for 12 minutes (or bake in the oven for 20)
Boil your noodles in one pan
In another pan fry off your diced red pepper
Stir in the garlic and chilli puree
Stir through the cream and a ladle of the noodle water
When the chicken is cooked, shred this with a knife and fork and add it to the sauce making sure it is well coated
Once the noodles are cooked add this to the pan too
Top with some fresh spring onion

title: Creamy Cajun Prawn Linguini
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Made Easy, p. 73
ingredients: cajun spice, onion powder, garlic powder and black pepper
method: Put your pasta on to the boil
In another pan spray with cooking spray and add your prawns
Season with the prawn seasonings listed
Remove the cooked prawns from the pan and use the same pan to make your sauce
Add in your butter, flour, cream and some pasta water to loosen up the sauce and whisk until you have a smooth consistency
Add in your sun dried tomatoes along with the sauce seasonings listed
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and stir through the grated parmesan cheese and some fresh parsley
Share into 2 bowls and add half of the prawns to each
Top with some more black pepper and grated parmesan cheese

title: Spicy Creamy Cajun Chicken Meal Prep
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 5
method: Put your rice onto the boil
Spray your diced chicken breast with cooking spray and season in oregano, garlic powder, cajun seasoning and sriracha sauce
Add this to the pan and fry off until cooked through and slightly charred then remove from the pan
In the pan then add the light butter, a tsp of lazy garlic, the diced onion, tomato puree, oregano, cajun seasoning and the milk
Once mixed well and onions softened, re add in the chicken
Pour over the parmesan cheese and stir well

title: Cheesy Chorizo & Chicken Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 7
ingredients: 40g reduced fat cheddar cheese (I used Sainsbury’s Be Good to Yourself range)
200g tomato & chilli pasta sauce (Lloyd Grossman brand)
method: Put your pasta onto the boil
In another pan fry off the chorizo and diced onion with some lazy garlic
De-skin your chicken sausages and break up in the pan and season with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and oregano
Add in your tomato sauce (if you don’t have any, use passata with some chilli flakes, paprika and oregano)
Add in half of the cheese
Once the pasta is cooked add this to the pan with the remaining cheese
Top with some more pepper and oregano

title: High Volume Peri Chicken & Halloumi Meal Prep
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 9
ingredients: medium chilli powder (leave out if you don’t like too spicy)
method: Wash the rice and put onto the boil for 10-15 minutes
Fry off your halloumi pieces on both sides for a few minutes then remove from the pan
To the pan add the peppers and mushrooms (or veg of choice) 4.Pour over the peri peri marinade onto the chicken and mix well 5.Add the chicken into the pan with the veggies
Season with the chilli & garlic seasoning and sprinkle over some peri peri salt
Once the chicken is cooked through add in the frozen peas and fry off for a few minutes
Then add in the cooked rice and season with some more of the above seasonings
Add in some chilli powder for extra spice and some garlic powder
Share it out into your meal prep dishes and top with the halloumi and with 20g of sweet chilli jam on each
Season with some parsley and chilli flakes

title: Sticky Harissa Salmon & Veg
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 11
method: Season your salmon with salt, pepper, garlic and paprika
In a bowl mix the harissa paste with the honey and then coat this over the salmon
Air fry your salmon for 15 minutes on 180 (or wrap in tin foil and bake in the oven on 180 for 20-25 minutes
Meanwhile chop up your asparagus and mushrooms and fry off with 1/2 tsp of lazy garlic
Once softened, add in the tinned tomatoes and stir through the
Philadelphia
Cook the mashed potato as per the packet instructions
Serve up once the salmon is cooked through

title: Hunters Chicken Sausages
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 13
ingredients: 6 chicken sausages (I used muscle foods but Heck & Aldi also do good ones)
30g grated Eat Lean cheese (could just use 60g cheddar if you don’t have Eat Lean this is just good on protein)
method: Wrap your chicken sausages in the bacon and place in an oven proof dish
Cook in the oven on 180 for 30 minutes
Remove from the oven and cover in the BBQ sauce and the cheese and put back in the oven for 10 minutes or until all the cheese has melted
Meanwhile, boil your broccoli and cook your mashed potato as per the packet instructions
This recipe was so good even as a meal prep the next day!

title: Creamy Bacon & Green Veg Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 15
ingredients: 60g reduced fat cheddar cheese (I used Eat Lean)
method: Put your pasta and broccoli onto the boil
Dice up your bacon rashers and fry these off on both sides for a few minutes with some salt and pepper
Sprinkle over some garlic powder
Once the bacon starts to brown add in your frozen garden peas
One the peas have softened, add in the creme fraiche and the Philadelphia- add in a splash of pasta water to loosen up the sauce
Once the broccoli and pasta is cooked, add this to the pan with the bacon
Sprinkle over your grated cheddar cheese, squeeze the juice of 1/2 a lemon and some more pepper and mix well
Share into your meal prep tubs!

title: Crispy Sweet Chilli Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 17
method: Dice up your chicken breast and spray with cooking spray
Season with onion powder, garlic powder and paprika
Cover with the corn flour and mix well until all the chicken is coated
Cook in the air fryer on 180 for 12 minutes (or you can fry this off in the pan and remove once cooked through)
In a pan fry off the sliced red pepper and red onion until soft
While this is cooking make your sauce: light soy, dark soy, sriracha, sweet chilli and honey and mix well
Once the chicken is cooked add this to the pan with the veg and pour over the sauce
Cook on high for a few minutes until all the chicken and veg are coated and the sauce goes nice and sticky
Microwave your rice as per the instructions
Then share into 2 meal prep dishes
Top with some pepper and sesame seeds

title: Chicken Satay
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 21
method: Dice up your chicken and add it to the pan
Dice your onion and pepper and add this to the pan and season with salt and pepper
While this is cooking make the sauce
In a bowl combine the sweet chilli, soy, honey and peanut butter
Add a splash of boiling water to loosen up the sauce and stir well until it’s nice and smooth
Once the chicken is cooked, pour over the sauce, bring to the boil for 2 minutes then lower the heat down to a low simmer for 5 minutes
Cook your rice in the microwave as per the instructions and share out into your prep dishes
If you serve with broccoli, add this to the dishes then top with half of the chicken satay in each
Top with a sliced spring onion and some sesame seeds

title: Creamy Pesto Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 23
ingredients: 20g reduced fat green pesto (Sacla is the brand I used found in Tesco)
method: Dice up your chicken and spray with cooking spray
Coat in half of the corn flour and mix well
Spray it again and coat in the remaining corn flour ensuring all the chicken is fully covered
Add to a frying pan and cook on both sides, remove once cooked through

Dice up your potato into small cubes, spray with cooking spray, season with salt, pepper and cajun seasoning and bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minute giving a shake half way (or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven on 200 for 25 minutes turning half way)
In a pan fry off the mushrooms & diced onion with a heaped tsp of lazy garlic
Add in half of the chicken stock and the spinach and let it wilt down
Add in the remaining stock, creme fraiche and the pesto and stir well, let it simmer until its a nice thick sauce
Add the chicken back into the pan and coat in the sauce
Plate up with the potatoes and season in salt and pepper

title: Creamy Chicken & Chorizo Gnocchi
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 25
method: Fry off the diced chorizo for 2-3 minutes then remove from the pan
In the same pan, add the diced onion and chicken
Season in paprika, chilli flakes and lazy garlic
Once the chicken is cooked add in the single cream and chicken stock
Add in the gnocchi and stir well, cover over for 4 minutes
Remove the lid and stir again then re-cover for another 2-3 minutes
Stir through the 18g of parmesan and some parsley
Serve up and top with the remaining parmesan and the previously cooked chorizo

title: Sweet Chilli Chicken Wrap
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 27
ingredients: 2 tortilla wraps (I use the Deli Kitchen carb lite wraps for 127 calories)

title: Chicken Satay Potato Salad
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 31
method: Cut the potatoes into cubes, spray in cooking spray and season with cajun spices
Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes shaking half way (or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven on 180 for 20-25 mins turning over half way)
Dice your chicken breast and spray with cooking spray, mix with 1tbsp dark soy sauce and a tsp of lazy garlic
Put this in the air fryer on 180 for 15 mins (you could also fry this off in the pan)
Let the chicken and potatoes cool down once they’ve finished cooking
Assemble your box with lettuce, chopped pepper, cucumber, grated carrots then add in the chicken and potatoes
For the sauce mix 1tbsp dark soy sauce, the peanut butter, honey and sriracha, add a splash of hot water to loosen the sauce up
Mix until a smooth sauce is formed then drizzle this over your salad
Pop in the fridge overnight and take for your meal prep the next day!

title: Bang Bang Chicken Potato Salad
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 35
method: Spray the chicken breast in cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and Aromat
Cook this in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes (or wrap in foil and bake in the oven on 180 for 20-25 minutes)
Dice up the baking potato into cubes, spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper, Aromat and cajun seasoning
Cook this in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes turning half way (or place on a baking tray bake in the oven on 180 for 20-25 minutes turning half way)
Prepare the salad, to a meal prep dish add the lettuce, chopped cucumber, grated carrot and sugar snap peas (fry these for 2-3 minutes and let cool)
For the dressing combine: the sesame oil, sriracha, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce and peanut butter and mix well
Add a splash of boiling water to loosen the sauce, keep mixing until you have a smooth consistency
Once the chicken and potatoes are cooked, let them cook before adding them to the salad
Then top each salad with half of the dressing

title: One Pot Pizza Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 37
method: To a pan fry off the diced chicken breast seasoned in
Aromat and Italian seasoning
Remove from the pan once cooked through
To the pan, add the diced red pepper and red onion and a tsp of lazy garlic and a sprinkle of oregano
Pour in the balsamic vinegar and stir
Add in the dried rice, passata and chicken stock and the cooked chicken
Stir well and season with salt and pepper

Cover over for 10-12 minutes on a simmer, stir then re-cover for another few minutes until the rice is cooked and has soaked up the water (you may need to add a little more if it isn’t quite cooked through)
Once cooked, top with the mozzarella and cheddar and the pepperoni slices
Place under the grill for 4-5 minutes until all the cheese has melted
Then top with the basil and the parmesan and enjoy!

title: Creamy Chicken, Bacon & Sweetcorn Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 39
method: Put the pasta onto the boil
In another pan fry off your bacon pieces on both sides then remove once cooked
Then add in the diced chicken breast and season in aromat, chicken seasoning, salt and pepper
Add in the diced onion
Once the chicken is cooked through add in the Philadelphia with some pasta water to create a creamy sauce
Sprinkle in the parmesan and stir well
Add in the cooked pasta along with the bacon and the sweet corn
Season with some garlic, salt and pepper
Serve up!

title: Cajun Chilli Beef & Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 41
ingredients: a sprinkle of chilli flakes (more or less depending on how spicy you like it)
method: Brown the mince in the frying pan with the beef stock pot
Add in the diced onion and pepper and fry to soften
Next, add the lazy garlic, cajun seasoning, pinch of cayenne, smoked paprika, chilli flakes, cumin and sweetener
Then add the tomato puree and the passata and mix well
Simmer for around 20 mins
Around 5 minutes before the end add in the kidney beans
Serve with rice & broccoli

title: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowl
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 43
ingredients: Chipotle seasoning (use paprika if you don’t have this)
method: Dice the chicken breast and coat in the chipotle paste along with some garlic powder, chipotle powder (or paprika), salt and pepper and let this marinade for 10-15 minutes
Then add the chicken to the pan and fry for 10-15 minutes until fully cooked
Mash up the avocado and dice up the tomatoes and add to a bowl
Slice up the jalapeños and add this to the bowl with some salt & pepper
Squeeze the juice of half a lemon and half a lime into the avocado mix and stir
Cook your rice and beans in the microwave as per the packet instructions
Serve up and enjoy!
Optional: serve with a spoon of sour cream (not accounted for in the macros)

title: Creamy Sweet Chilli Halloumi & Chorizo Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 45
ingredients: 40g Reduced sugar (I use Blue dragon) sweet chilli sauce
method: Put the pasta onto the boil
Slice up the halloumi into squares and fry on both sides for 2 minutes then remove from the pan
Fry off the chorizo for 2-3 minutes and remove from the pan
In the same pan add in the diced onion and red pepper with some chilli flakes (leave out if you don’t like it too spicy), salt and pepper
Pour in the sweet chilli sauce and the Philadelphia, add a splash of pasta water and mix well until a creamy sauce is formed
Sprinkle in the parmesan (save a little to sprinkle on top at the end) and a little more pasta water and mix well
Once the pasta is cooked, drain and add to the pan with the sauce along with the halloumi and chorizo 8.Stir well until all is coated
Dish up and top with the remaining parmesan

title: Honey & Garlic Chicken Meal Prep
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 47
method: Wash and drain the rice before putting it onto the boil
Dice up the chicken breast and cover with a tsp of garlic, half of the soy sauce and the honey
Mix well and let marinade for 10 minutes
Add this to the pan for 10 minutes
While the chicken is cooking, slice up the carrot and onion
When the chicken is cooked through, remove from the pan
Add the carrot and onion and a tsp of lazy garlic
Once the veg has softened, push to one side of the pan and scramble the egg on the other side
Add the cooked rice to the pan and the remaining part of the soy sauce
Add in the frozen peas and let them cook for 2-3 minutes before re-adding in the chicken breast
Serve up and top with some sliced spring onion & sesame seeds

title: Creamy Pesto Bacon & Broccoli Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 49
method: Weigh out your dried pasta and put onto the boil
Slice your bacon medallions and fry off in a pan on both sides for a few minutes
Season with garlic and black pepper
Chop up the broccoli into small pieces and add to the pan
Once the broccoli has started to soften and the bacon is browned add in the pesto and soft cheese
Pour in half of the stock, mix and simmer until the sauce has thickened up
Once the sauce has started to thicken, pour in the remaining stock and stir well
Add in the frozen peas
Once the pasta has cooked add this into the pan with the parmesan (save a little for the end)
Season with some more pepper
Serve up and top with the remaining parmesan

title: One Pot Hunters Bbq Chicken & Bacon Rice
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 51
method: Chop up the bacon medallions and chicken breast into small pieces and season in bbq seasoning, paprika and garlic, fry off until cooked through then remove from the pan
Fry off the diced onion and pepper until softened and season with garlic
Pour in 40g of the BBQ sauce, the Worcester sauce and the tomato puree
Add in the dried rice followed by the chicken stock
Cover over for 10-15 minutes until the rice is cooked (you may need to add a little more water in)
Add the chicken back into the pan with the bacon (save some for the topping)
Sprinkle over the grated cheese and the remaining bacon and place under the grill for 3-4 minutes until the cheese has melted
Pour over the remaining 20g BBQ sauce and top with a sliced spring onion

title: Pizza Pasta Bake
source: Fit Food Diary: Meal Prep Volume 2, p. 53
method: Air fry or grill the sausages
Put the pasta onto the boil
Drain the pasta once cooked and chop up the sausages and add to the pan with the pasta
Pour in the pizza sauce (you can also use pasta sauce Lloyd Grossman have good sauces for the calorie range)
Mix well then transfer into an ovenproof dish
Top with your mozzarella, mushrooms and sliced pepperoni
Bake in the oven on 180 for 10-15 minutes or until all the cheese has melted
Season with some chilli flakes

title: Double Cheeseburger
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 4
method: Roll the beef mince into 2 balls and flatten into a pan
Season with salt & pepper and fry on both sides untill cooked through
Lightly toast the bun
In a bowl, combine the mayo, sriracha and some sliced jalapeños
In the pan, top one burger with a cheese slice, layer the other burger on top and top with another cheese slice
Layer the bun with lettuce, the burgers & cheese and the spicy mayo sauce
Wrap in tin foil for 2-3 minutes to let the cheese melt further

title: Honey Bbq Chicken Burger
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 6
method: Cover the chicken breast in paprika and cajun seasoning
Crush up the corn flakes and whisk the egg in another bowl
Dip the chicken in the egg wash and then cover in the cornflakes
Put in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes or bake in the oven for 20
In a bowl make your spicy sauce by mixing the mayo and sriracha
In a pan make your honey bbq sauce by combining the garlic puree, bbq sauce and the honey
When the chicken is cooked, coat it in the honey bbq sauce
Lightly toast your brioche bun and layer with lettuce, the chicken and cheese slice, spread the spicy sauce on one side of the bun

title: Chinese Chicken Curry & Sides
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 8
ingredients: salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder & Chinese 5 spice
method: Roast the chicken in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes or bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes
Put the mini spring rolls in the oven or air fryer for 12 minutes
In a pan fry off the onion until softened
Once the onion is soft, add in the frozen peas
When the chicken is cooked, shred with a knife and fork and add into the pan
Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and Chinese 5 spice
Mix the curry powder with some boiling water and pour over the chicken
Cook the rice in the microwave
Serve with the prawn crackers

title: Bbq Chicken Wrap Pizza
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 10
ingredients: 25g bbq sauce (5g is for the topping)
method: On a tortilla wrap. add the ketchup and 20g of the BBQ sauce and spread this out
Sprinkle the tomato sauce seasoning over
Sprinkle the cheeses over and top with the chicken & sweetcorn
Cook in the oven for 10-15 minutes on 180 degrees
Top with some pizza seasoning

title: Shredded Chicken Loaded Potato Nachos
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 12
method: Slice your potato into thin circles
Spray them with olive oil spray/ fry light and season with paprika and cajun
Bake them in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes or in the oven for 20-25 minutes
Season the chicken in the same seasonings and bake for 15 minutes
Shred the cooked chicken with a knife and fork
In a bowl, combine the mayo and sriracha and mix well
Stir the chicken through the sauce
Top the cooked potatoes with the chicken
Layer the cheese and put under the grill for a few minutes until all the cheese has melted
Top with the jalapeños, salsa and soured cream

title: High Protein Loaded Fries
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 14
method: Slice your potato into chips, spray with cooking spray and season with the cajun spices
Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15-20 minutes giving it a shake in the middle (or you can place on a baking tray and bake in the oven on 180 for 25-30 mins, turn the chips half way through cooking)
In a pan, fry off your turkey mince and season in cajun, salt and pepper
Once cooked through add in the passata and the sriracha
When the chips are cooked, top with the turkey and the mozzarella
Place under the grill for a few minutes until all the cheese has melted

title: Sweet Chilli Halloumi Flat Bread
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 16
ingredients: 1 flat bread (I use Deli Kitchen Greek flat bread)
80g halloumi (use reduced fat to lower the calories)
10g reduced sugar sweet chilli sauce (I use Blue Dragon brand)
method: In a bowl combine the honey, paprika, chilli flakes and a splash of water
Slice the halloumi and coat in the honey mixture
Fry the halloumi in a pan on both sides for a few minutes on a high heat
Then turn the heat down and add in the onion and pepper for a few more minutes
Then layer up the flat bread with the lettuce, peppers and onion and the halloumi
Top with the sweet chilli sauce and perinaise

title: Salt & Pepper Chicken Flatbread
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 18
ingredients: 1 flat bread (I use Deli Kitchen Greek flat bread)
method: In a pan fry off the onion and red pepper
Add in the chicken and lazy garlic and cook on both sides
Season with salt & pepper seasoning and chilli flakes
Combine the honey and sweet chilli sauce and cook on a high heat for 2-3 minutes then turn down
Toast the flat bread on both sides
Layer the flat bread with lettuce, the chicken, peppers & onion
Top with the mayo
Wrap in tin foil & enjoy!

title: Chicken & Halloumi Gyros
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 20
ingredients: 1 flat bread (I use Deli Kitchen Greek Flat Bread)
method: Season your chicken & spray in cooking spray cook in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes (or in the oven for 25)
Season your chips & spray in cooking spray also cook in the air fryer on 180 for 15 mins, give them a shake half way! (or bake on a baking tray in the oven for 25 mins)
Grill or air fry your halloumi until golden brown
Tzatziki: mix the Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, lemon juice and garlic powder together
Toast your flat bread
Layer up!
Later the onions and tomatoes followed by the chips, chicken and halloumi
Drizzle over the tzatziki
Wrap in tin foil and enjoy!

title: Butter Chicken 2 Ways
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 22
method: Season the diced chicken breast in 1 tsp of all of the listed spices and mix well with the Greek yogurt
Add this and the diced onion to the air fryer
Add in the passata, tomato puree and the butter
When its ready to cook season with some more of the garam masala, a small amount of the turmeric and chilli powder and the sugar
Mix well and cook on high for 2 hours
After 2 hours add in the cream, stir and return the lid for another 10 minutes
Macros served with 170g microwave long grain rice: 569 calories, 36g protein, 63g carbs, 19g fats
Macros served in a wrap with 30g grated mozzarella: 587 calories, 44g protein, 41g carbs, 27g fats

title: Sweet Bbq Hassle Back Halloumi Chicken
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 24
method: Slice some slits into the chicken about 2/3 of the way through
Push in the halloumi
Spray the chicken with cooking spray and season in the bbq seasoning
For the sauce mix the bbq sauce and honey and brush over the chicken- make sure to get it all covered
Dice up your potatoes and spray in cooking spray and season in the bbq seasoning
Place both in the air fryer 0n 180 for 15 minutes (or bake in the oven on 180 for 20 mins, you may need a little longer for the potatoes)
Meanwhile, boil your broccoli
Once all are cooked, season with some salt and pepper and a sprinkling of grated parmesan cheese

title: Chicken Pizza Burger
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 26
ingredients: 15g red cheese (I used Eat Lean cheese)
method: Spray your chicken breast in cooking spray and season in salt, smoked paprika, oregano and garlic powder
Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven on 180 for 20-25 minutes
While the chicken in cooking grate your cheese and create your garlic sauce which is the Greek yogurt, garlic powder and parsley mixed together
When the chicken in cooked top it with the pizza sauce, then the pepperoni and then the cheese and place this under the grill until all the cheese has melted
Lightly toast your bun then assemble topping the chicken with the garlic sauce
Enjoy!

title: Filet O’Fish
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 28
method: Pat your cod fillet dry with a piece of kitchen roll then coat in the egg white
Coat in the bread crumbs, salt and pepper
Air fry for 12-15 minutes on 180 or bake in the oven for 20 minutes
Meanwhile assemble the sauce, combine the
Greek yogurt, mayo, tomato relish, fresh dill, salt and pepper
Lightly toast your bun and layer with the cheese, cooked fish and top with the sauce
Tip: wrap the burger up in tin foil for a few minutes and warm in the air fryer or in the oven to melt the cheese.

title: Garlic & Parmesan Chicken Burger
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 30
method: Spray your chicken breast in cooking spray and season with the smoked paprika, onion granules and the garlic granules
Dip in the whisked egg and then in the breadcrumbs combined with 5g parmesan cheese
Air fry for 15 minutes on 180 or bake in the oven for 20 minutes
In a pan combine the milk, Philadelphia, other half of the parmesan cheese, squeeze of lemon juice, salt, pepper, parsley and oregano
Stir until smooth
Lightly toast your bun and layer with some lettuce
Coat the chicken in the sauce then drizzle any remaining sauce over the top
Add to the bun and enjoy!

title: Chorizo & Bacon Mac & Cheese
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 32
ingredients: 1tbsp sriracha (optional, leave out if you don’t like spice)
40g grated reduced fat cheese (I used Eat lean cheese)
method: Put your macaroni pasta onto the boil in one pan
In another fry off the diced chorizo for 3-4 minutes then remove from the pan
In the same pan fry off the chopped up bacon on each side for 2-3 minutes and season with onion powder and garlic powder
Add in your Philadelphia with a splash of the pasta water (add this in in small amounts until you find the consistency you like, I like my sauce quite thick so I didn’t add much around 4-5 tbsp)
Then add in your grated cheese and mix well until you have a thick, creamy sauce
Optional: add in some sriracha for a little extra spice, if you don’t like too much spice add in some paprika instead
Once your pasta is cooked, add this to the pan and stir well until it is all coated in the sauce
Plate up and top with the chorizo from earlier

title: Slow Cooker Enchiladas
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 34
ingredients: 40g reduced fat red cheese (I used Eat Lean)
method: Put the chicken breasts into the slow cooker along with the diced red pepper and diced onion
Add in the sugar, salt, pepper and fajita spices
Pour in the passata and the tomato puree and mix well
Cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4
Once the chicken is cooked, remove from the slow cooker and shred with a knife and fork then add back into the slow cooker and mix well
Add (around 1/4) of the grated cheeses & mix until all the cheese has melted
Assemble the wraps and pop into an oven proof dish
Spread over any remaining tomato sauce and the grated cheese on top
Optional: top with some jalapeños
Bake in the oven for around 10 minutes on 180 or until all the cheese has melted
The macros are for 2 enchiladas per person

title: Sweet Nandos Hassle Back Chicken & Halloumi
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 36
ingredients: 90g halloumi (use light halloumi to reduce cals further)
Optional: a drizzle sriracha mayo (not counted in the macros)
method: Cut the slices into your chicken breast, spray with cooking spray and cover in the Nandos rub
Cut your halloumi into thin pieces and slot into the slices in the chicken
In a bowl mix the Nandos (or any peri peri) sauce with the honey and pour over the chicken & halloumi
Make sure it is all well covered
Slice your potato into chips and spray with cooking spray
Season with cajun seasoning and garlic powder
Put both into the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes (shake the chips half way) or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven for 20-25 minutes
While this is cooking boil your broccoli
Plate it up and season with the peri peri salt (Aldi’s version is just as good) and sriracha mayo for some extra spice!

title: Nandos Sunset Burger
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 38
ingredients: 120g chicken thigh (use chicken breast if you want to reduce the calories a little more)
method: Spray your chicken with cooking spray and cover in the Nandos marinade (if possible let it marinade in the sauce in the fridge for a few hours prior)
Pop in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes, turning half way (or wrap in some foil and bake in the oven for 20 minutes on 180
Toast your bun
In a bowl, mix the mayo, mixed herbs and lemon juice
Spread this over the bottom of the bun
When the chicken has 1 min left to cook, pop the cheese slice on top and let it melt
Assemble the burger with the lettuce, chicken and cheese and then top with the sweet chilli jam

If serving with chips cut 120g of potato into fries, spray with cooking spray and season in cajun spices. Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15 mins turning half way or in the oven on 180 for 20-25 minutes turning half way, 120g potato will add approximately 131 calories to the total.

title: Sweet Chilli Beef & Curried Noodles
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 40
method: Slice your sirloin steak into thin strips (cutting off all of the fat) and season with salt and pepper
Cover with the whisked egg then the corn flour
Fry off in the pan for 3-4 minutes turning half way (make sure the steak slices are separated)
Remove from the pan and set your noodles off to boil in another pan
Fry off a sliced red pepper and red onion and 1 spring onion
While they are softening in a bowl, mix the rice vinegar, sweet chilli sauce, tomato puree, ketchup, soy, sweetener, chilli flakes, garlic and Chinese 5 spice
Pour over the veg then re-add the beef and stir well until everything is coated in the sauce
Drain your noodles
Mix the curry powder with a small amount of water until you have a thick curry paste
Pour this over the noodled and mix well until they are all coated in the sauce
Serve up into 2 dishes and top with some fresh chilli, fresh spring onion and some sesame seeds

title: Chicken Parmigiana
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 42
method: Slice your chicken breast into thin pieces and season with salt and pepper then spread over the mayo
Combine the bread crumbs with 5g parmesan and some oregano
Dip the chicken breast in the bread crumb mix and bake in the air fryer on 200 for 10 minutes (or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven on 180 for 15 minutes )
Meanwhile, put the pasta onto the boil
In another pan add in the diced onion with some oregano, a tsp of lazy garlic salt, pepper and the tomato puree and fry off for a few minutes
Add in the passata to the pan with the sugar and mix well
Once the pasta has cooked, add most of the sauce and mix (save 2 spoon fulls for the top of the chicken)
Top with 70g of the grated mozzarella and 10g parmesan, pop in the oven for 5 minutes on 180 until all the cheese has melted
Once the chicken has cooked, top with the remaining sauce, remaining mozzarella and cook for a further 5 minutes
Top the pasta bake with the chicken and remaining parmesan and a sprinkle of oregano

title: Air Fryer Bang Bang Salmon
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 44
method: Mix the sriracha, mayo and sweet chilli and spread half of the sauce over the salmon fillet
Bake in the air fryer on 200 for 10 minutes
Put the noodles onto the boil
Slice up the baby corn, green beans, red pepper and the spring onion (save the green top for later ) and spray with cooking spray and bake for 3 minutes in the air fryer on 180
When the noodles are cooked add this to the air fryer with the veg, the dark soy, the remaining bang bang sauce and the lazy garlic
Mix well and cook for a further 2 minutes
Plate up with the salmon and drizzle over the sriracha mayo, the rest of the spring onion and the fresh chilli

title: Cajun Chilli Beef Tacos
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 46
ingredients: 2 portions of the cajun chilli beef
mince recipe (in meal prep guide volume 2)
method: Re-heat the chilli in the pan for 5 minutes
Dip each taco into the mixture on both sides
Fill half of the tacos with the chilli and sprinkle 1/4 of the cheese in each
Add in the jalapeños if using
Fold over the tacos
Spray a pan with some cooking spray and fry off on both sides until crispy
The macros are per 2 tacos

title: Creamy Chicken & Bacon Pie
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 48
method: Spray the diced chicken breast in cooking spray and season with salt, pepper, Aromat and garlic powder
Coat in the corn flour and mix well
Air fry on 180 for 5 minutes, stir then return for a further 5 minutes (you could also fry in a pan)
Grill or air fry the bacon rashers then cut in to small pieces
Add the chopped leek in with the chicken for 1-2 minutes
Transfer the chicken, bacon and leek into your oven proof dish and pour in the creme fraiche and the chicken stock and mix well
Egg wash the sides of the dish then cover with your pastry
Egg wash the pastry
Bake the pie in the air fryer on 180 for 10-15 minutes (or in the oven for 15-20)

title: Beef Chow Mien
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 50
method: Add the beef to a bowl and add the bicarbonate soda, cornflour, and 1 tsp dark soy sauce and mix well
Set to the side for 10-20 minutes to marinate in the sauce
Next, add to a pan with the sesame oil, fry off on both sides for 3-5 minutes
Meanwhile boil the noodles in a separate pan
Once the noodles are cooked, drain and add to the pan with the beef
Add the remaining tbsp of soy sauce and fry for a further 3-4 minutes until the noodles start to char
Slice the spring onion, then add these to the noodles along with the beansprouts
Fry for a further 3-4 minutes and then serve!

title: Marry Me Chicken Pasta
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 52
method: Thinly slice the chicken into 2 breasts
Spray with cooking spray and season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, salt & pepper
Fry off on both sides in a pan until cooked through & remove
Put the spaghetti onto the boil
In another pan fry off a diced onion with the tomato puree
Once softened, add in the chicken stock, a sprinkle of basil and soft cheese
Once the spaghetti is cooked add this to the pan with the sauce with the parmesan (saving a little for the end)
Plate up the spaghetti & top with the chicken and drizzle the remaining sauce in the pan over the chicken
Top with the remaining parmesan

title: Salt & Pepper Chicken Curry Flat Bread
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 54
ingredients: 2 flat breads (mine were 232 cals from aldi)
40g (dried weight) mayflower curry powder (or any curry powder)
method: Cut your potatoes into chips, spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and aromat
Cook in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes turning half way (or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven for 20-25 minutes on 180 turning half way)
Mix the cornflour with salt, pepper and a dash of Chinese 5 spice
Whisk 1 egg in another bowl
Dice the chicken and egg wash then coat in the cornflour mix
Cook in the air fryer on 180 for 12-15 minutes turning half way (or you can fry off in a pan)
Dice the pepper and onion and fry off, season with salt and pepper and some aromat
Add the chicken and chips to the pan once cooked and pour over the soy sauce
Toast the flat bread
Mix the curry powder with 100ml boiling water
Load up the flat bread with the chicken, chips & veg and drizzle over the curry sauce
Top with some sliced spring onion and chilli flakes

title: Crispy Chilli Sticky Chicken Tacos
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 56
method: Slice the chicken breast into strips and coat in 1 tbsp soy sauce and season with salt and pepper
Dip in the egg wash and then coat in the corn flour
Cook in the air fryer on 180 for 13-15 minutes or fry off in a pan until cooked through & crispy
For the sauce mix the tomato puree, sweet chilli sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, honey, ketchup, 1/2 tsp garlic powder and the chicken stock
Slice up the pepper and fry off in a pan
Cover with the sauce and then add in the chicken once cooked
Ensure the chicken is well coated in the sauce and fry on a high heat so that it goes really sticky
Fill the mini wraps with the chicken & peppers
Optional toppings: a drizzle of sriracha mayo & spring onions

title: 5 Guys Fake Away
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 58
ingredients: Sauce of choice (i used BBQ but not counted in the macros so make sure you account for what ever sauce you choose)
method: Cut the potato into chips, spray with cooking spray and season with aromat & cajun
Bake in the air fryer for 12 minutes on 180, shake then return for a further 10 minutes (or place on a baking tray and cook in the oven for 20 minutes on 180 turning them half way)
Roll the mince into 2 50g balls, flatten in a pan and fry off on both sides for around 3-4 minutes
Meanwhile, toast your bun and slice up the lettuce
Season the burger patties with salt and pepper
Layer a cheese slice on each burger and then add to the bun with the lettuce
Add your toppings of choice then wrap in tin foil
Place in the air fryer for 2-3 minutes to allow the cheese to melt further
Serve up and enjoy!

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 60
method: Put the pasta onto the boil
In another pan fry off the sliced up bacon medallions on both sides until browned
Add in the diced onion and mushrooms
Season with a tsp of lazy garlic and pepper
For the sauce whisk 2 eggs and add in the parmesan and a dash of pepper
Once the pasta is cooked, add this to the pan with the bacon along with a few tbsp of pasta water
Remove the pan from the heat and pour in the sauce
Mix until all the pasta is coated with the sauce 9.Serve up & enjoy!

title: Crispy Nandos Chicken Burger
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 62
method: Cut the potato into chips and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and aromat
Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes turning half way (or place on a baking tray and oven cook on 180 for 20-25 minutes turning half way)
Cut the chicken breast into 2x 100g slices
On a plate spread the flour with some salt, pepper and garlic powder and coat the chicken breasts with this
Coat each chicken breast in 10g of light mayo
In a bowl crush up the cornflakes into small pieces and dip the chicken breasts in this so they are fully coated
Season again with pepper
Bake in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes or in the oven for 20
In a bowl combine the remaining mayo and the peri sauce
Toast the buns and layer with the lettuce and peri/ mayo sauce
Place the cooked chicken into the bun layering with a cheese slice
Wrap the burger in tin foil and place in the air fryer or oven for a few minutes to allow the cheese to mely
Serve up with the chips and season with some peri salt if you like!

title: Cajun Chicken Pizza Loaded Fries
source: Fit Food Diary: Fakeaway Guide, p. 64
method: Slice up the baking potato into chips, dab dry with a piece of kitchen roll
Spay with cooking spray and season with oregano and smoked paprika
Cook in the air fryer on 180 for 15 minutes turning half way or on a baking tray in the oven on 180 for 25 minutes also turning half way
Season the chicken in cajun seasoning and fry in the pan with the diced pepper and onion
Once the chicken is cooked, remove from the pan and shred it with a knife and fork
Return the chicken to the pan and pour in the passata with some more of the cajun seasoning
Let this simmer on a low heat
Meanwhile in a bowl add the Greek yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, garlic powder and parsley add a splash of water and mix well
Layer the chips then the chicken and then sprinkle the cheese on top
Add your sliced up pepperoni and jalapeños (if using)
Place under the grill for 5 minutes or until all the cheese has melted
Top with the garlic sauce & enjoy!
